name: sweet-eye-coffee
description: Sweet Eye Coffee Roasters — Expo app (mobile/) and its API (server/) on the sweet_eye_coffee MySQL database.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c "#D4A373,#8FC79B" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix mobile start"
scripts.check: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint
